description: Engineering/agent knowledge (GOV-13): brain memory items captured read-only from the brain's agent/items route (integrations/knowledge_source.py, the knowledge the Portal Knowledge Service serves as namespace knowledge.graph), cited brain://<namespaceKey>/<id>@<generation>-<capture>. Every reader is trimmed per brain namespace (audience brain:<namespaceKey>, granted by the Workbench's namespace authority; an unnamed namespace grants nobody; personal namespaces are never captured). Items are untrusted T3 leads, never business facts: the type has no identifier property and no link to a business record, and its text is untrusted source text.

object_types.description: One captured brain memory item version, keyed by the brain item id (memory.items uuid). Title and snippet are untrusted source text; updated_at is the brain's own edit time, never a business date.

bindings.note: One object per brain item id; one version per captured updatedAt (capture store kind brain). The same memory items plx-brain brain_timeline lists (readMemoryItems, order recent, personal namespaces excluded) and brain_get_node loads as memory_item nodes (agentic-swarm@e228067 apps/vmc-web/src/lib/vmc/knowledge/mcp-http-tools.ts runTimeline, runGetNode); other graph node kinds, facts and edges are not typed.

properties.name: namespace
properties.description: The brain namespaceKey (the reader's audience unit).

wb.knowledge_source.note: NamespaceAuthority (caller/namespace authority before retrieval) and the GET-only agent/items capture into the versioned capture store (kind brain).

up.vmc_items.note: KnowledgeMemoryItemV1: id, title, snippet, namespaceKey, memoryType, projectSlug, updatedAt.

ctx.brain.note: Brain hits are leads (derived_knowledge/T3), never cited facts about business records; trim before showing.
